# Walters W.102 marginalia

Marginal creatures and scenes from Walters Art Museum W.102, a Flemish book of hours of around 1300 whose margins are filled with animal musicians, hybrids and small architectural vignettes.

Part of [Ducktape Assets](https://github.com/adrian729/ducktape-assets). Set id `walters-w102`, historical, 4 assets, version 1.0.2.
